title: Mobile app mock-up
intendedUserGoal: Understand the daily status and confidently use core mobile actions.

strongFindings.rootCause: Small circular controls may be hard to identify and activate confidently.
Repeated cards and decorative hero treatment compete in a constrained viewport.

rootCauseObservations: Constrained viewport clarity and target confidence should drive the critique.
mergeGuidance: Merge decorative competition and dense cards when they affect the same scan path.
scannerSpamToAvoid: Do not overclaim touch target failures without reliable sizing evidence.
